question: were the 297 live-accepted views sufficient, and is a selection from the full recording better?

files.groups_c.json: 200 selected groups from the full corpus (includes corner views 89/5682/4019/6241)
files.groups_union.txt: 343 groups extracted and detected in one pass
files.coverage_d1_d8.json: D1-D8 for the three variants (tools.wizard.coverage, one common source)

conclusion: (c) is better on coverage (D4 satisfied, 6/8 vs 5/8) and conditioning (804 vs 1804) but worse on precision (held-out 1.20 vs 0.77 px, RMS 1.00 vs 0.65). The 297 were sufficient for precision and insufficient for corner observability; the right fix is to add corner views to the accepted set, not to replace it.
